{{Top}}
The '''Galard Stables hives''' was a [[Geonosian hive/Legends|Geonosian hive]] populated by gladiator survivors of the [[Petranaki arena|arena]]. Although technically exiled from their clan, the inhabitants of the Galard Stables were nonetheless revered by other [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] for their ability to survive.
